annotation.summary_en: New Zealand's May 2024 national submission to the UN Secretary-General on autonomous weapon systems. It supports a binding international instrument prohibiting AWS that cannot comply with international humanitarian law and regulating the rest to ensure human control. It also covers humanitarian, legal, security and ethical risks, and interim voluntary measures.
key_provisions_or_claims: Seeks binding prohibition of AWS that cannot comply with IHL or ethical requirements
Seeks regulation of other AWS to ensure sufficient human control or oversight across the lifecycle
Does not favour a blanket ban at this time; autonomy is a spectrum
Weapons reviews are necessary but insufficient without specific rules
Supports interim non-binding measures such as the US Political Declaration and wider UNGA engagement
